name: quantamental-engine-v3-frontend
description: BUILD-ONLY workspace for the v3.0 React UI. esbuild precompiles the JSX under src/ to static/v3/, and the vendored runtime deps are copied to static/vendor/. NOTHING here runs at engine runtime — FastAPI serves the precompiled output statically. node_modules is gitignored; the vendored assets + precompiled bundle are committed. See build.mjs.
